name: IEX_DELINQUENCIES_ALL
description: Stores transaction data about customer delinquencies.

columns.name: DELINQUENCY_ID
columns.description: Primary key.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Standard Who column.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the HZ_PARTIES table.

columns.name: CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS table.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HZ_CUST_SITE_USES_ALL table.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the AR_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL table.

columns.name: PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the AR_PAYMENTS_SCHEDULES_ALL table.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the delinquency.

columns.name: UNPAID_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Value of the unpaid reason entered by the collector.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Standard Who column.

columns.name: PROGRAM_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Standard Who column.

columns.name: SOURCE_PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Standard Who column.

columns.name: DELINQUENCY_DETERMINATION_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date in legal entity time zone of the transaction when the delinquency status was last updated to current, predelinquent, or delinquent.

columns.name: LATEST_RESEND_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the latest resend action. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_IEX_LATEST_RESEND_STATUS.
